title: Unit 3: Cultural Values - Key Vocabulary & Terminology
content:
📌 Culture (Noun)
• English: The customs, arts, social institutions, and achievements of a particular nation, people, or social group.
• Amharic: ባህል / የህብረተሰብ ልማድ
• Synonyms: Heritage, Tradition, Customs
• Antonyms: Barbarism, Unculturedness
• Example: Respecting different cultural values fosters unity among diverse communities.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Cultural Values (Noun Phrase)
• English: The core principles and ideals upon which an entire community exists and functions.
• Amharic: የባህል እሴቶች / ማህበራዊ መመሪያዎች
• Synonyms: Core beliefs, Principles, Standards
• Antonyms: Deviance, Normlessness
• Example: Hospitality and mutual support are strong cultural values in Ethiopia.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Egalitarianism (Noun)
• English: The doctrine or belief that all people are equal and deserve equal rights and opportunities.
• Amharic: እኩልነት / ሁሉም ሰው እኩል ነው የሚል እምነት
• Synonyms: Equality, Fairness, Justness
• Antonyms: Elitism, Discrimination, Inequality
• Example: The Awramba community was founded on the principles of egalitarianism.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Subservient (Adjective)
• English: Prepared to obey others unquestioningly; less important or subordinate.
• Amharic: ተገዢ / ዝቅ ያለ / አዛዥ የሚጠብቅ
• Synonyms: Subordinate, Obedient, Passive
• Antonyms: Dominant, Independent, Masterful
• Example: Awramba promotes gender equality where women are not subservient to men.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Ostracized (Verb / Adjective)
• English: Excluded or banished from a society, group, or community.
• Amharic: የተገለለ / የተገፋ
• Synonyms: Excluded, Isolated, Shunned
• Antonyms: Welcomed, Accepted, Included
• Example: The community was ostracized because their lifestyle differed from surrounding groups.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Lauded (Verb / Adjective)
• English: Highly praised or admired publicly.
• Amharic: የተመሰገነ / የጸደቀ
• Synonyms: Praised, Extolled, Acclaimed
• Antonyms: Criticized, Condemned, Blamed
• Example: Awramba is lauded as a successful model for poverty reduction.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Alleviate (Verb)
• English: To make suffering, pain, or a problem less severe or easier to bear.
• Amharic: ማቃለል / መቀነስ
• Synonyms: Reduce, Ease, Relieve
• Antonyms: Aggravate, Worsen, Increase
• Example: Hard work and community projects help alleviate poverty in rural areas.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Diligent (Adjective)
• English: Showing care, steady effort, and conscientiousness in work or duties.
• Amharic: ትጉህ / ሰራተኛ
• Synonyms: Hardworking, Conscientious, Assiduous
• Antonyms: Lazy, Careless, Negligent
• Example: The diligent work ethic of the community members led to their economic success.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Obscene (Adjective)
• English: Offensive or disgusting by accepted standards of morality and decency.
• Amharic: ነውረኛ / በጣም የሚጠላ
• Synonyms: Offensive, Repulsive, Abhorrent
• Antonyms: Decent, Respectable, Proper
• Example: In their community, theft and dishonesty are viewed as highly obscene.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📌 Endeavor (Noun / Verb)
• English: An earnest, prolonged, or industrious attempt to achieve a goal.
• Amharic: ጥረት / ተግባር
• Synonyms: Attempt, Effort, Venture
• Antonyms: Inaction, Idleness, Passivity
• Example: The village is famous for its endeavor to eliminate poverty through cooperation.
